found.quote: Along with other Universities, our position is not to prohibit the use of GenAI tools, but rather to provide all members of the academic community with support and guidance on how GenAI can be used responsibly and ethically
The University has reviewed its academic misconduct procedures, and reference to use of GenAI tools is incorporated.

unsure.quote: Course teams working with Learning and Teaching Directors and Co-ordinators should determine how GenAI can be incorporated into programme design and learning and teaching activity.
unsure.why: Course teams decide incorporation in teaching, not explicitly student permitted use.

unsure.quote: As GenAI tools evolve and our institutional good practice develops, so will the nature of teaching, learning and assessment pedagogies.
unsure.why: Evolving practice stated, not clearly that this guidance will be updated.

unsure.quote: The use of Gen AI tools cannot therefore be separated from the development of critical thinking and analytical skills.
